scope: Diagram lint with official Wokwi CLI, and native Arduino CLI compilation. No cloud simulator execution, physical wiring, or hardware measurements. All supported single module/board pairs plus one combined interactive design per board are linted. All modules on UNO, ESP32 and Pico plus the Nano/Mega combined examples are compiled.

issues.text: HC-SR04 5 V — SparkFun SEN-15569: 5–5 V ayrı besleme gerekir; kartın güç pinleri kontrol edilmeli.
